exercises.title: A complete safety check
exercises.instruction: The worked example rejected one capture. Now use the safety check to choose and play White's sound capture.

preparation.instruction: 1. Check your captures. Scan the whole board. White's king has two legal captures, so an ordinary move is unavailable.

feedback.initial: Before every move: check your captures, test a candidate, inspect their complete reply, then count and decide. Watch one worked example first.
feedback.success: White must capture. Choosing a route still requires checking its consequences.

preparation.instruction: 2. Test a candidate move. Watch the king capture up-right. Inspect its destination and the protection it leaves behind.

feedback.initial: The king takes one man, but its new square is beside Black's central attacker with an empty landing beyond it.
feedback.success: The candidate must be tested against Black's reply.

preparation.instruction: 3. Inspect their complete reply. Watch Black jump the king. Look for every continuation and any immediate White recapture.

feedback.initial: Black captures the king and stops. White's remaining man cannot recapture that attacker. Include backward jumps and alternative routes when checking kings.
feedback.success: The full reply loses White's king with no immediate recovery.

preparation.instruction: 4. Count and decide. White lost a king; Black lost a man. Reject this candidate and test the other legal capture before moving.

feedback.initial: Count both sides' losses and ranks after all jumps and immediate recaptures. A compulsory capture cannot be declined, but a better legal route can be chosen. Continue to restore the starting board and play it.
feedback.success: Compare the other legal route on the starting board.

feedback.initial: The actual board is restored. Repeat steps 2–4 for the other capture: picture its landing, check Black's reply, then count before choosing.
feedback.selected: Check both legal king landings. Which one avoids Black's recapture?
feedback.success: White wins one man without losing its king. You rejected the worked example's losing route and played the sound alternative.
feedback.goalMiss: That route gives up the king for a man, as the example showed. Check Black's reply after the other landing.
feedback.invalidPiece: Step 1: a capture exists. Use White's king.
feedback.invalidDestination: Choose a legal king capture landing.

exercises.title: Check what you leave behind
exercises.instruction: Use the four-step check to move a black man safely without removing the middle blocker.

threat.label: IF THE MIDDLE BLOCKER MOVES, WHITE CAN TAKE TWO

feedback.initial: 1. Check your captures: none exist. 2. Test a candidate's departure and destination. 3. Inspect White's full reply. 4. Count and decide before moving.
feedback.selected: What protection does this piece leave behind? The marked route opens only if the middle blocker moves.
feedback.success: White has no capture. You preserved the blocker and checked the safety of the whole position, not just the moving man.
feedback.goalMiss: That move opens White's double jump and loses two teammates. Keep the middle blocker and test another candidate.

exercises.title: Include the whole reply
exercises.instruction: Use the safety check to stop Black's king without conceding either capture branch.

feedback.initial: 1. Check your captures. 2. Picture a candidate move. 3. Inspect every jump in both king branches. 4. Count the complete result and choose a move that saves all your men.
feedback.selected: Test whether your move removes the shared first target or denies the shared landing. Saving only one second target leaves another route.
feedback.success: The king has no capture. You checked its whole reply and stopped both branches.
feedback.goalMiss: Black can still capture after that move. Check the shared first target and landing rather than just one second jump.

exercises.title: A sound exchange
exercises.instruction: Move White's king into the support position you checked, then complete the recapture.

preparation.instruction: The example moves the king into support. Black can take the advanced man along the marked route. Count White's legal recapture: is this an equal exchange or a material loss?

threat.label: BLACK'S CAPTURE AFTER THE SUPPORT MOVE

options.label: Lose material
options.feedback: Check the king's capture after Black lands. White can recover the attacker without losing its king.

feedback.initial: 1. No White capture exists. 2. Test the support move. 3. Inspect Black's complete reply. 4. Include White's recapture before comparing losses.
feedback.success: Keep the candidate: White loses one man and recaptures one black man. The king survives. Now play the support move and verify the exchange.

followUps.instruction: Black played the capture you checked. Recapture with White's supporting king.

feedback.initial: Finish the exchange before judging its result.
feedback.selected: Take the attacker with the king.
feedback.success: Each side lost one man and White kept its king. You checked and played a sound exchange.

feedback.initial: The starting board is restored. Play the support move you checked.
feedback.selected: Move the king onto the diagonal behind Black's landing.
feedback.awaitingReply: Watch Black's predicted capture, then use the support you created.
feedback.success: Each side lost one man. Your safety check included the recapture.
feedback.goalMiss: For this exercise, make the checked support move with the king. It must be able to recapture Black's attacker.

exercises.title: Apply the routine yourself
exercises.instruction: Use the full safety check to choose Black's sound capture. Play it when you have checked the reply and counted the result.

feedback.initial: 1. Check your captures. 2. Test a candidate move. 3. Inspect their complete reply. 4. Count and decide. Compare alternatives before choosing.
feedback.selected: Picture both complete king captures and White's reply after each. Count losses and ranks.
feedback.success: Black captured a king without losing a piece. You chose the sound route using the safety check. Repeat the same four steps before every move.
feedback.goalMiss: White can recapture your king after that landing. Reject the king-for-man loss and test the other legal capture.
feedback.invalidPiece: Black has a compulsory capture. Select its king.
feedback.invalidDestination: Choose a legal king capture landing.
